figurative_meaning_bn: দিনের শেষে 'রাত্রি মঙ্গলজনক হোক' এই শুভকামনাবিশেষ
figurative_meaning_en: A special wish at the end of the day meaning 'May the night be auspicious'
example_sentences_in_bangla: কথা শেষ করে তিনি বললেন, শুভ রাত্রি।
example_sentences_in_english: After finishing the conversation, he said, good night.
note: This is a standard polite farewell in Bengali, derived from Sanskrit roots but commonly used in everyday secular contexts.
